tickets.title: Prepare manual transfer package for joint taxable account
tickets.text: Prepare manual transfer package preserving in-kind transfer instruction for Lena Copperwisp's joint taxable account at Silver Marmot Brokerage to Velvet Acorn Custody, including approximately $1.42 million in holdings with $410,000 low-basis Pocket Lantern Robotics stock.
tickets.evidence: They agreed that a manual package preserving the in-kind transfer instruction for the taxable holdings would be prepared, due 2024-08-02.

tickets.title: Resolve identity verification upload loop for Velvet Acorn Custody
tickets.text: Resolve repeated identity verification upload loop for Lena Copperwisp's new Velvet Acorn Custody registration rather than requiring resubmission of identification through the portal.
tickets.evidence: Lena asked Apricot Compass Advisory to help resolve the repeated upload loop rather than asking her to resubmit the same identification through the portal again; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-07-31.

tickets.title: Coordinate cost basis import for Pocket Lantern Robotics shares

tickets.evidence: They agreed to coordinate with Velvet Acorn Custody so the transferred lots are not booked as unidentified positions, due 2024-08-06.

tickets.title: Obtain trust certification for Copper Firefly Revocable Trust registration
tickets.text: Obtain acceptable trust certification or equivalent trustee authority document for Copper Firefly Revocable Trust to finalize taxable account registration at Velvet Acorn Custody for Lena Copperwisp.
tickets.evidence: the receiving custodian still needs an acceptable trust certification or equivalent trustee authority document before the registration can be finalized; this remains needed, with a 2024-08-05 date.

tickets.title: Start rollover IRA setup and coordinate direct-rollover instructions
tickets.text: Start Velvet Acorn Custody rollover IRA setup for Lena Copperwisp's Pocket Lantern Robotics 401(k) balance of approximately $612,000 and coordinate direct-rollover instructions after plan access is confirmed.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to start the Velvet Acorn Custody rollover IRA setup and coordinate direct-rollover instructions after plan access is confirmed, due 2024-08-09.

tickets.title: Reconcile owner name mismatch on Colin Copperwisp's inherited IRA
tickets.text: Reconcile titling discrepancy on Colin Copperwisp's inherited IRA at Silver Marmot Brokerage where legal name differs from draft receiving paperwork before submitting transfer request to Velvet Acorn Custody.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to reconcile the titling before submitting another transfer request so the inherited IRA registration is not rejected, due 2024-08-07.

tickets.title: Obtain current statement for Colin Copperwisp's inherited IRA
tickets.text: Obtain current statement showing inherited IRA registration for Colin Copperwisp's inherited IRA at Silver Marmot Brokerage as requested by Velvet Acorn Custody.
tickets.evidence: obtaining the statement remains needed, with a 2024-08-04 date.

tickets.title: Track transfer sequence against Silver Marmot Brokerage fee increase deadline
tickets.text: Track transfer sequence for Lena Copperwisp's household accounts against Silver Marmot Brokerage's announced household service fee increase to complete moves before the fee change takes effect.
tickets.evidence: they agreed to track the transfer sequence against that client-imposed timing target, due 2024-08-23.
